tools.description: Sign in with a wiki username and password (HTTP basic auth). Creating, editing, deleting, reading and searching tiddlers all require a valid credential first; this session is what $actor resolves to for subsequent calls. Fails if the username/password do not match a configured credential.

username.description: A configured wiki username (matches the Credential.username CSV column).

password.description: The plaintext password for that username (matches Credential.password).

messages.auth: You are not signed in. Call sign_in with a configured wiki username and password first.

_evidence.ref_code: searches the CSV credentials list for a username/password match (basic.js:58); challenge/admin auth flow is the single auth exit and all tiddler routes gate on the basic authenticator

Tiddler.title: GettingStarted
Tiddler.text: How to get started editing this wiki.

summary: TiddlyWiki5 is a Node.js personal-wiki server: it stores Tiddler records (a title-keyed page with freeform fields) in an in-memory store keyed by title, persists them to disk as .tid/.meta/.json files via the filesystem sync adaptor (or syncs to a remote TiddlyWeb server), and serves them over HTTP with full CRUD (PUT/GET/DELETE tiddlers, JSON search, render) plus basic-auth via a Credential store (username/password CSV). Sign in with a wiki username/password, then save/fetch/render/delete tiddlers and search by a filter expression; the server status endpoint reports the authenticated user and write capability.

_no_edges.why: leaf persistence op: no pre-check, calls no other operation; only writes the tiddler file to disk (plugins/tiddlywiki/filesystem/filesystemadaptor.js:83)
leaf persistence op: no pre-check, calls no other operation; only unlinks the on-disk file (plugins/tiddlywiki/filesystem/filesystemadaptor.js:130)
remote-sync leaf: no pre-check, calls no local op; issues an external PUT to the TiddlyWeb host (tiddlywebadaptor.js:247)
remote auth leaf: issues an external POST to the TiddlyWeb host, no local store interaction (tiddlywebadaptor.js:157)
